pages.title: Under Apple Pressure
pages.text: Collect completed Apple Juice from an Apple Press.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Press uses apples and a container; consult its native help and recipe. A completed pressing earns the objective.

pages.title: Press apple juice
pages.text: The Press processes apples first, then bottles the juice. It also supports its own honey-processing recipes.
